description: You are the Change Manager at a mid-sized technology company. After repeated VPN outages affecting 450 employees, the network team has determined that the Cisco Catalyst 2960 switches in Buildings A and B are end-of-life and must be replaced. You need to create and submit a formal Change Request through the ITSM system. Your tasks: (1) Create a new Change Request with the title 'Campus Network Core Switch Replacement - Buildings A and B', Change Type 'Normal', with a detailed reason explaining the EOL situation, High impact, and High risk. Set a rollout plan and backout plan. (2) Link the existing open VPN connectivity request (the one about VPN dropping every 30 minutes) to this Change as a related incident. (3) Add at least one Change Task to this Change — for example, a pre-deployment configuration backup task. (4) Set the Change status to 'Requested' to submit it for CAB review. Log in with username: administrator, password: administrator.
